बिना किसी प्रमोशन के थिएटर्स में आई भक्ति ड्रामा Hanuman Ansh ने ओवरसीज मार्केट में झंडे गाड़ दिए हैं! 🔥

नॉर्थ अमेरिका (USA और कनाडा) में लगभग 50 दिनों यानी 7 हफ्तों का शानदार सफर पूरा करने के बाद फिल्म ने कुल $2.795 million (26.6 करोड़ रुपये) का धमाकेदार कलेक्शन कर लिया है। इसके साथ ही यह 2026 की नॉर्थ अमेरिका में 5वीं सबसे ज्यादा कमाई करने वाली बॉलीवुड फिल्म बन गई है।

कमाई के आंकड़ों की बात करें तो USA से $2.08 million (19.78 करोड़ रुपये) और कनाडा से $715K (6.8 करोड़ रुपये) का कलेक्शन आया है। भाषा के हिसाब से हिंदी वर्जन ने $2.722 million (25.89 करोड़ रुपये) और तेलुगु वर्जन ने $73K (69 लाख रुपये) जुटाए हैं। 💥

पहले ही हफ्ते में $1 million का आंकड़ा पार करने वाली इस फिल्म ने सिर्फ मजबूत वर्ड-ऑफ-माउथ के दम पर बॉक्स ऑफिस पर यह ऐतिहासिक कामयाबी हासिल की है। 🚩

ctx.title: Hanuman Ansh North America Box Office (Closing Collection): Wraps Up Its Blockbuster Run As Bollywood’s 5th Highest-Grosser Of 2026!
ctx.summary:
Hanuman Ansh performed much better than expected at the North American box office, overtaking a biggie like Bhooth Bangla. 
 The post  Hanuman Ansh North America Box Office (Closing Collection): Wraps Up Its Blockbuster Run As Bollywood’s 5th Highest-Grosser Of 2026!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
After a mind-blowing run in the Indian market, Hanuman Ansh surprised everyone with its strong performance in the overseas market as well. The biggest international contribution came from North America (USA and Canada), where it scored big and emerged as a box-office blockbuster. After staying in theaters for almost 50 days, the film has finally ended its run in the territory with an impressive total. Keep reading for a detailed closing collection report!
The Bollywood devotional drama was released with zero promotion in India, but thanks to strong word-of-mouth, it saw a major turnaround and emerged as a historic success. The impact of such a run was clearly evident in North America, as pre-sales alone showed good momentum. Further, with favorable audience feedback, it saw good box-office legs.
Within a week, Hanuman Ansh grossed over $1 million, sealing its fate as a big success. Over the course of its seven-week run, it performed really well despite several new releases. According to the closing collection update, the devotional drama wrapped up with $2.795 million at the North American box office. It equals 26.6 crore in Indian rupees.
Out of $2.795 million , the USA contributed $2.08 million ( 19.78 crore ), and Canada contributed $715K ( 6.8 crore ). Speaking about the language-wise breakdown, the original Hindi version scored $2.722 million ( 25.89 crore ), while the Telugu version scored $73K ( 69 lakh ).
With $2.795 million, Hanuman Ansh has ended its run as Bollywood’s fifth-highest-grossing film of 2026 at the North American box office. With biggies like Ramayana and King coming in the next two months, the list will see new additions.
